name: io.github.chrischall/eventbrite-mcp
description: Eventbrite for Claude — your tickets/orders, organizer data, and public event discovery

environmentVariables.name: EVENTBRITE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal OAuth token (eventbrite.com/platform/api-keys); needed for account tools

environmentVariables.name: EVENTBRITE_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the fetchproxy concentrator port (fleet default 37149).

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bridge bind interface, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; exists for a hosted child in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the long-term bridge identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller.
